metadata.title: A Visitor Made of Light — A2
metadata.synopsis: Na desmontagem de uma estação espacial, Sana encontra a mensagem holográfica deixada por uma antiga construtora.
metadata.author: English Roulette — rascunho com assistência de IA

scenes.title: Someone above the Desk
scenes.narration: Sana was checking an old workshop before the station was taken apart. Above a desk projector, a blue figure appeared: an older woman in a work shirt. "I helped build this place," the recording said. Sana stopped by the window bench. The visitor was only light, but its voice sounded pleased to have company again. She decided to hear the whole message.
scenes.prompt: Who did the projected woman say she was?

options.text: Someone who arrived to take Sana home
Someone who helped build the station
Someone who owned the transport ship

scenes.explanation: The story says: "I helped build this place".

scenes.title: The Bench by the Window
scenes.narration: The builder's recording described the bench beneath the workshop window. After long shifts, she and her team had sat there to watch the stars. She had saved the message so future workers would know that the station was once a home. Sana opened the desk drawer and found a white memory card. It could hold a copy before the equipment was removed.
scenes.prompt: Why had the builder saved the message?

options.text: To ask future workers to build another window
To warn that the workshop tools were missing
To show that the station had once been a home

scenes.explanation: The story says: "the station was once a home".

scenes.title: What Is Worth Keeping?
scenes.narration: The white card had room for the complete projection or a simpler voice recording. The station archive could preserve the full scene. Sana could also save the voice, then send the projector to the new workshop for reuse. The builder's words would survive either way. Looking at the worn bench, Sana considered what she wanted the next workers to receive.
scenes.prompt: What would survive in either choice?
scenes.explanation: The story says: "The builder's words would survive either way".

Save the voice and reuse the projector

scenes.title: A Place in the Archive
scenes.narration: Sana copied the complete projection onto the white card and labelled it for the archive. Before leaving, she watched the builder beside the window bench one last time. Later, in the station museum, visitors could see that modest workshop and hear why it mattered. Sana had not saved the building, but she had kept a way for other people to enter its memory.

scenes.title: A Voice in the New Workshop
scenes.narration: Sana saved the voice onto the white card and prepared the projector for reuse. In the new workshop, she played the builder's message for her team. They listened beside an ordinary workbench, then left a place where everyone could sit after a shift. The old window was gone, but the reason for its bench had travelled with them. Sana felt ready to begin again.

options.text: A copy of the old station window
A private room for Sana alone
A place to sit together after a shift

scenes.explanation: The story says: "a place where everyone could sit after a shift".

visualContinuity.locations: A decommissioned orbital station: entrance corridor opens to an old workshop, with a desk projector, a memory card socket and a wide window above a built-in bench. A tool rack stands against the rear wall.

authoringNotes.learningFocus: Identificação de quem fala, finalidade de uma mensagem e contraste entre registros; passado simples.
authoringNotes.proposedAudience: Adultos aprendendo inglês; sem violência gráfica. Faixa etária não é um recurso implementado no site.
authoringNotes.reviewStatus: Produção e envio à VPS concluídos: WAVs gerados a partir do texto exato e conferidos por transcrição automática; artes 2D dark inspecionadas e corrigidas por cena. Grafo e questões verificados pelos testes. Não declara revisão auditiva humana nem certificação CEFR.
authoringNotes.supportedGameplay: Cenas, narração pré-gravada, uma pergunta por cena, uma bifurcação e dois finais. Objetos, tecnologias e ações são elementos da ficção; não requerem inventário, fala do jogador, combate ou novos eventos de gameplay.
authoringNotes.levelNote: Nível e tamanho são propostas editoriais, não certificação automática CEFR.
humanReviewChecklist: Revisar compreensão e naturalidade do inglês no nível indicado.
Revisar se cada pergunta tem exatamente uma resposta apoiada no texto.
Revisar continuidade, motivação, tom e ambos os finais.
Revisar o registro de autoria e autorização do texto; preencher créditos e evidências das mídias que forem produzidas.
Produzir e escutar WAVs a partir de audioText; revisar e produzir as imagens-base e loops.
Importar como rascunho, validar mídia no servidor e publicar somente após revisão.

visualStyle.description: Animação 2D cinematográfica dark: personagens adultos desenhados, contornos limpos, cel shading, cenários pintados, paleta contida e sombras profundas com pistas legíveis. Terror com tensão sombria; sem pessoas fotorrealistas.
